utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Sounds good—what time should I be ready?

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: Around 7:30 should work for me. I’ll let you know if anything changes.

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Great, I’ll be ready at 7:30.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: I’m happy to help, but I need to know the pickup time and who’s riding first so I can plan the route.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Right, can you confirm the pickup time and who’s first? I just want to make sure we’ve got the route straight.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: I still need the pickup time and the first rider before I can map it out.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Oh, right — the carpool. I probably missed the latest change, so just tell me what time and I’ll do my best to be there.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Sure thing — I just need to double-check the time, because I’m a bit foggy on it too. I’ll tell you as soon as I remember.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: No worries, just text me when you’ve got it. I’ll keep an eye out and make sure I don’t miss it again.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Yeah, I can do the carpool. I’ll let everyone know the plan and keep it moving.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Thanks, Vik — that really helps. I’ll pass it along to the others.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Sounds good — I’ll tell everyone the carpool details and keep things moving.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Sorry I’m late — is there still room in the carpool?

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Yep, there’s still room — hop in.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Thanks, Gus — I’m in.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: Let’s keep it simple—what time are we leaving, and who’s riding with us?

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Let’s leave at 7:30, and I’ll text Jamie and Priya to hop in with us.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: Sounds good—7:30 works for me. Just let me know when Jamie and Priya are set.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Hey Sam, are we still on for the carpool tomorrow?

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Yep, we’re still on for tomorrow. I’ll be ready at the usual time.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Great — what time should I be outside?

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Hey Opal, I’m happy to help coordinate the carpool—what time are we thinking, and who’s all in?

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: Thanks, Jules — I’m thinking 8:15 at the corner by Maple, and so far it’s you, me, and Nina.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Sounds good — 8:15 at the Maple corner works for me, and I’ll let Nina know we’ve got her covered.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: Sure — I can help with the carpool. What days and times are we looking at?

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Thanks, Mara — I’m thinking school pickup on weekdays around 3:15, but I can be flexible if that doesn’t work for you.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: 3:15 on weekdays should work for me. Let me know which days you want me to take, and I’ll plan around it.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: I can keep track of the carpool supplies and make sure we’ve got what we need. Just tell me the schedule, and I’ll jot it down.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Great, thanks, Cleo — I’ll send you the schedule in a minute.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: Perfect, I’ll be ready to note it down when you send it.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Oh, I heard the carpool’s still on for tomorrow, but a couple folks might be running a little late. I can check in and make sure everyone’s sorted.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: Thanks, Tess. That would help a lot—just let me know if I should wait a few extra minutes.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Sure thing — I’ll check in and let you know if you should give it a few extra minutes.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Before I confirm anything, can you remind me of the pickup time and who’s riding with us?

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: Pickup is at 3:15, and it’s just Mia and Ben riding with us.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Thanks—3:15 with Mia and Ben. I’ll confirm that and let you know once it’s set.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Hey Ira, I’m good for carpooling—just keep it simple and let me know the time.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Sounds good, Bo — I’ll keep it simple and send you the time.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Perfect, thanks—just text me the time and I’ll be ready.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Sure — I’ll tell everyone the carpool plan and make sure it’s clear.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Thanks, Vik — I really appreciate it.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Of course — I’ll pass it along and keep everyone in the loop.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Oh, right — the carpool. I might’ve missed the latest update, what changed?

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: I’m sorry, I haven’t checked the latest update yet. I can look into it and let you know.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Thanks, that’d help a lot. Just let me know when you find it.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: Yeah, I’m good with the carpool. What time were you thinking?

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: I can do 7:30 if that works for you.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: 7:30 works for me.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Absolutely — I’ll get the carpool details organized and make sure everyone knows the plan.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: Thanks, Rosa — I’ll keep track of the pickup spot and time so nobody misses it.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Perfect, Opal — I’ll confirm the drivers and send out the final schedule soon.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: I’m a little worried about the timing—what time are we leaving, and do we have enough seats for everyone?

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: We’re aiming to leave at 7:30, and yes—we’ve got enough seats for everyone.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: Okay, that helps—I just want to make sure everyone knows to be ready a little early.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Just to confirm, is the carpool still on for tomorrow?

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Let me double-check the details before I confirm—can you remind me of the pickup time?

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Sure — I think it was around 8:15, but I’m not 100% sure.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: Sounds good — let's keep it simple and set a clear pickup time. If you tell me the route, I’ll stick to it.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Yeah, works for me — I’ll text you the route and a pickup time once I’ve got it locked in.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: Perfect — I’ll wait for your text and be ready at the pickup time.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Oh, I’ve just been hearing bits and pieces about the carpool—what’s the latest?

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: We’re still checking who can drive which days, and I’m keeping an eye on the supplies list too. I’ll let you know as soon as the schedule is settled.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Thanks, Cleo — I appreciate the update. I’ll wait to hear once the schedule is settled.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Oh—right, the carpool. I’m sorry, Mara, I forgot the details, but I’m happy to help figure it out.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: No worries, Oren — let’s sort it out together. I can check who needs a ride and what time works.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Thanks, Mara. Just tell me who needs a ride and what time, and I’ll do my best to keep it straight this time.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: Sounds good — what time should I plan on for pickup, and which kids are we taking?

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Let’s do 7:45, and I’ve got Maya and Ben on my list.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: Perfect, I’ll plan for 7:45 and take Maya and Ben. See you then!
